title: Napo's optimization
description: A collection of mostly client-side mods to enhance your daily game experience without impacting on performances
body:
Napo's optimization is a modpack made by Itsnapo for minecraft 1.21

![Image of the modpack's logo](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f9f05b777e563d45cd024395ddc000e137dbf357.png)

**BETTER VANILLA EXPERIENCE**
The mods in this modpack are aimed to enhance the player experience keeping the game vanilla style.

**PERFORMANCE**
The mods in this modpack improve the game performance to allow low-end pcs to keep up with the game and grant the best experience.

**DETAILS**
There are 3D elements and other details to give more depth to the game and a responsive enviroment.

If you think that any mod should be added/removed to the modpack text me under my channel's comment section and we'll figure it out!
